summary: Kamala Harris ke pita Donald Harris Jamaica se America aaye the aur unki maa Shyamalan Gopalan ek Bharatiya-American thi. Donald ne 1964 mein America mein kadam rakha aur 1965 mein nagrikta kanoon bana, jisse Asia se logon ka aana shuru hua. 1957 mein Dalip Singh Saund pehle Bharatiya-American pratinidhi bane, aur ab Bharatiya-Americans ki sankhya 40 lakh hai. Pew Research ke mutabik 40% Bharatiyon ke paas masters degree hai aur inki aabadi ka sirf 7.5% garibi rekha se neeche hai. 2016 ke survey mein 48% Bharatiya-Americans Democrat hain. H1B visa par Trump ke niyam ne unhe prabhavit kiya, lekin Biden ke aane se ummeed hai ki unka bhavishya sudhrega.
